title: Lyra Direct Covid-19 Mastermix Distribution
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (v3.21.0 or later), Opentrons Temperature Module GEN2, 96‑Well Aluminum Block for the Temperature Module, Opentrons P20 Single‑Channel Pipette, Opentrons 20 µL Filter Tip Rack, Opentrons 4‑in‑1 Tube Rack, NEST 96‑Well PCR Plate, an Eppendorf 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, and the Lyra Direct SARS‑CoV‑2 Assay Kit (mastermix).

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 20 µL Filter Tip Rack in Slot 2 of the OT‑2 deck. Load any additional labware (e.g., the tube rack holding the 1.5 mL tube and the 96‑well PCR plate) according to the protocol’s deck map.

steps.title: Load protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle, upload a custom labware definition if required, and then upload the protocol into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the tip rack, tube rack, and PCR plate (and the pipette) following the app’s calibration workflow.

steps.title: Distribute mastermix
steps.instruction: With the Opentrons P20 Single‑Channel Pipette, aspirate 15 µL of mastermix from the 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and dispense it into each designated well of the standard 96‑well PCR plate (the number of wells is specified by the user).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, press “Run” to execute the mastermix distribution protocol.
